config_fields.help: Print partner for create_order (required by Bookvault): Bookvault_UK, Bookvault_US, Bookvault_AU or Bookvault_CA.

me.note: GET /v4/account: {details{firstName, lastName, email, accountRole}, settings{planName}, setup{addedFunds, placedOrder}, ...}. The account payload also carries billing and bank details; treat `account` as sensitive.

list_products.note: GET /v4/titles?titlesPerPage=&pageNumber= lists YOUR library titles (print-on-demand books) with specifications and pricing in `raw`; `query` and `category` are not accepted (POST /v4/titles filters are not mapped). `id` is the 13-digit ISBN.

get_product.note: GET /v4/title/{ISBN}: one library title with publishing progress, specifications (pages, binding, size, stocks), pricing and linked apps in `raw`.

create_order.note: Places a real print order that Bookvault charges to the account (production + dispatch). `shipping_address` is Bookvault's address {addressee, address1, address2, town, county (2-letter state for US/CA), countryCode (ISO), postCode, email, telNumber}; `items` are orderLines [{lineNumber (1, 2, ...), isbn, quantity}]; `shipping_option` is required and is the service rule Quickest, Cheapest, Tracked, CheapestTracked or NotSpecified. The print partner comes from the `partner` setting; docRef (your reference) is a fresh UUID. Orders shipped outside the partner's country also need a customsDeclaration, which this tool does not send. Validate first with POST /v4/order/validate (not mapped).

get_order.note: GET /v4/order?type=PodRef&value={id} (the podRef create_order returns): identification, metadata{status, dateCreated, partner}, financials.orderCost{productionCost, dispatchCost, tax, grandTotal}, fulfillment{address, service, trackingDetails{trackingNumber, combinedURL, servName}}.

not_offered.quote_shipping: POST /v4/dispatch requires areaCode (the delivery postcode), shipmentDate, currency and serviceLevel besides orderLines and countryCode, and GET /v4/dispatch needs the parcel weight and partner; the vocabulary's product_id/country/quantity cannot supply the postcode or date.
not_offered.track: No tracking-events endpoint: the order record carries a single fulfillment.trackingDetails {trackingNumber, combinedURL, servName} (see get_order's tracking_number/tracking_url).
